name: OddsReaper Island
blurb: Where the storm never breaks, the House still stands. OddsReaper Island is a felt-topped mesa ringed by dice-stone cliffs, its odds boards glowing cyan beneath endless lightning. Skulls mark the bets that died; money bags, the ones that paid. Brew Wager Herbs and parlay your luck, drink from the storm-fed cistern, tend Coinback goats and Dicebeak hens. Every sunrise is a roll of the dice. The Reaper always knows the odds.
